# Server Rules Welcome to the Ignis Space Station 14 server! We have a few general rules for you to follow while you're here. Please give them a cursory glance.
1. FOLLOW THE RULES OF ESCALATION. Do not attack without provocation, and only defend yourself within a reasonable expectation.
2. DO NOT SELF ANTAG. If you are not an Antagonist, follow station rules. Murder as a non-antagonist is against our rules.
3. Do not select an Antag role if you are not familiar with how Space Station 14 as a whole works.
4. Do not have any part of your Discord username within your SS14 Character name, please.
5. No ERP.
6. Don't be a dick. Don't ruin other people's roleplay experience.
7. Follow the larger Ignis rules while in this server.
8. Do not meta out of game using comms. While you can be in Discord and talk about what is happening, do not use this maliciously.
